layout.body:
Subject: TechHub shipment
Dear Ms. Turner,
TechHub has shipped the order you placed on Thursday. It should arrive by Monday. Please make sure the package contains what you ordered. Returns will only be accepted within 3 business days of your package’s arrival. Thank you for your purchase.
Regards,
James Lee

questions.stem: When is the latest Ms. Turner will receive her order?
questions.analysis: When is the latest Ms. Turner will receive her order? 原文依据：It should arrive by Monday. 包裹最晚周一送达。 (A) 最晚周一 → 正确 (B) 最晚周二 → 错误 (C) 最晚周三 → 错误 (D) 最晚周四 → 错误

questions.stem: What is Ms. Turner advised to do?

options.D: Check the contents of the package

questions.analysis: What is Ms. Turner advised to do? 原文依据：Please make sure the package contains what you ordered. 请确认包裹内是您订购的商品。 (A) 查看退货政策 → 错误 (B) 寄回填好的保修单 → 错误 (C) 支付尾款 → 错误 (D) 检查包裹里的物品 → 正确
